_comment: WordPress + WooCommerce: exclude auth, shop and AJAX paths, cache the rest.
Rules are ordered and the FIRST match wins, including exclusions -
so every 'enabled: false' rule must come before the catch-all at the end.
Cookie names below are matched against cookie NAMES only, never values.

rules._comment: WP AJAX and cron. admin-ajax.php is used by logged-out visitors too, so it must be excluded by path, not left to the cookie bypass.
WooCommerce AJAX lives in the query string on any path (/?wc-ajax=get_refreshed_fragments), so it needs a query match.
WP admin, login, cron, XML-RPC and the REST API.
WooCommerce endpoints. Adjust these slugs if the shop uses translated or renamed pages.
Preview and customiser links carry per-user nonces.
Everything else: cache GET/HEAD 200s for 5 minutes, but never for a visitor whose cookies say they are logged in, mid-checkout, or otherwise personalised.
